title: Nvidia Stops Selling Advanced AI Chips to China
excerpt: Nvidia halts shipments of its advanced AI chips to China, reversing a previous plan despite earlier approval from the White House.
body_html:
Nvidia has halted shipments of its advanced artificial intelligence chips to China, despite receiving approval from the White House in December of last year to sell them.

The announcement was revealed by interim CEO Colette Kress during an earnings call. This decision marks a notable shift for the company regarding its market strategy in the region.
